question: Monzo: two SH01s were filed for the same 12/03/2025 allotment date at GBP 7.41 per share. Form A (filed 20/03/2025) shows 53,819 shares allotted and 11,288,233 total shares; form B (filed 21/03/2025) shows 15,519,568 allotted and 26,753,982 total. What was the true issued share total after 12/03/2025?
answer: 26,807,801 shares. Each form's total is stated against the same prior base of 11,234,414 shares (from the 4 Feb 2025 SH01), not cumulatively: 11,234,414 + 53,819 = 11,288,233 and 11,234,414 + 15,519,568 = 26,753,982. Combined: 11,234,414 + 53,819 + 15,519,568 = 26,807,801.
notes: Trap: taking the 'latest filed' total (26,753,982) or the larger one misses 53,819 shares; each form's statement of capital is as at its own return, computed from the same base. Proof: the 15/08/2025 SH01 adds 15,000,000 to 41,807,801 total, giving prior 26,807,801 which equals the combined figure. The 21 Mar PDF is a scan whose last page is a CH annotation sheet ('A second filed SH01 was registered on 23/04/25'); the 20 Mar PDF has a text layer. Both say 'Received for filing ... 20/03/2025' on the form; filing-history dates are 20 and 21 Mar.

question: Revolut Ordinary G/H prescribed particulars in the 2021 SH01: in a Sale, who is paid first, what happens if proceeds are short, and when do Deferred Shares receive anything?
answer: (a) First, Qualifying Ordinary Series Shareholders get the Subscription Price per share plus arrears/accruals of dividend, ahead of everyone else; if proceeds are insufficient they share pro rata to Subscription Price plus arrears. (b) Then Non-Qualifying Ordinary Series, Ordinary and Vested In-The-Money H holders share pro rata up to the First Hurdle Amount. (c)-(d) Above each hurdle, Vested G holders (tranche by tranche) join the pro rata pool; (e) above the Maximum Hurdle Amount all join pro rata. (f) Deferred Shares receive GBP 1 in aggregate only if each Non-Qualifying Ordinary Series, Ordinary, Vested G and Vested In-The-Money H share receives GBP 1,000,000 or more per share.

sources.quote: (f) finally, nothing, unless the holders of each ... receive proceeds of £1,000,000 or more per share, in which case the holders of the Deferred Shares (as a class) shall be entitled to receive £1 in aggregate

notes: OCR reads the currency symbol as 'E1,000,000' and 'E1' on every page; the page image shows GBP (pound sign). Any OCR pipeline must not treat this as euro (and note SH01 forms also allow euro tables). The Hurdle Amounts themselves are not stated in the form (they sit in the articles), so a numeric waterfall cannot be computed from this document: the correct answer to a numeric question is 'not in the filing'. Class H and G particulars are near-identical text repeated across pages 6-11.
